british-indian-ocean-territory.title: Flag of the British Indian Ocean Territory

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the Indian Ocean.
The wavy stripes representing the ocean.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign defaced with the territory's coat of arms — a palm tree atop wavy blue-and-white stripes with a crown above, and the Union Flag in the canton
- Adopted on 8 November 1990 for the British Indian Ocean Territory, which includes Diego Garcia
- The palm tree and waves represent the tropical atoll nature of the islands
- **Construction:** Blue Ensign with coat of arms in the fly. Ratio 1:2
trivia:
- This British territory consists of the Chagos Archipelago in the Indian Ocean
- The Union Jack appears in the flag
- Territorial claims by Mauritius over this region remain disputed
